system.description: At 17th level, your reputation as a gunfighter is well earned, and you are a true master of the art. If you and another creature agree to a duel, you gain advantage on the first attack you make with a light firearm in the first round of the duel. If both rolls would result in a hit, you instead critically hit. If one roll is a crit and the other would hit, you add an extra die to the critical hit damage roll. If both attacks would crit, you add the extra die and then maximize the damage of all dice.
